summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for the default app opening screen:
1. 'Server external viewer' button inside the Start Menu to launch the app in a new tab in full screen.
2. All App windows closed by default on startup with deep frosted-glass blurred backgrounds.
3. Complete removal of touchpads, virtual mouse cursor, and mouse settings icons.
4. 'Raj Expo Digitals' flagship animated live wallpaper as default background.
5. Smooth entrance and exit transition animations for the Home screen and all App-in-App windows.
6. Screen touch pop-up ripple animations, notification badge pop-ups, and animated top status ticker ('Processing', 'Loading', 'Opening', 'Waiting', 'Warning', 'Error', 'Completed', 'Natasha's Notifications').
7. HMR/WebSocket error suppression in server.ts, vite.config.ts, and index.html per environment constraints.
